init_multigrid_schedule: init a MultigridSchedule to update training config with multigrid hyperparameters for long or short cycle mode
update_long_cycle_shape: update the long cycle training shape and batch norm type before each epoch
get_long_cycle_schedule: get the long cycle schedule of base shapes and corresponding training epochs from config
print_schedule: print and log the multigrid training schedule with base shapes and epoch counts
get_current_long_cycle_shape: get the current long cycle base shape given a schedule and epoch index
